title: Caramelised onion ramen

source.title: Meera Sodha's recipe for vegan caramelised onion ramen

ingredients.name: Rapeseed oil
ingredients.amount: 4 tbsp, plus a little for the noodles

ingredients.name: Salt
ingredients.amount: ½ tsp, plus more to taste

ingredients.name: Cooking sake
ingredients.amount: 2 tbsp, or rice wine or dry sherry

instructions: Peel and finely slice the onions and garlic. Finely slice the chilli. Cut the choi sum into 6cm pieces.

Warm the oil in a large heavy pan over a medium heat. Add the onions, garlic and salt, stir to coat and cook for 10 minutes, until slick and translucent. Turn the heat to low and cook for 30 more minutes, stirring every 5 minutes, until the onions break down into a soft, sweet, caramel-coloured paste.
Add the chilli and stock and bring to the boil. Turn down to a simmer, stir in the sake, soy and miso, then taste and adjust the seasoning. Turn off the heat.
Cook the noodles as the packet says, drain, refresh under cold water and stir in a little oil so they do not stick.
Just before serving, bring the broth back to the boil, drop in the choi sum and cook for 1 to 2 minutes, until just tender.
Divide the noodles between four bowls, ladle over the broth and greens, and drizzle with chilli oil.
